lee: Quick heads-up — starting bring-up for sundial-int6 (6-bit per-channel prototype) against conch-emb-512 fp16 on product_holdout_25k. CI run: https://ci.internal/9001. Tracking recall@1/10/100, silhouette, centroid-drift, jaccard_top10.
maria: Run config? batch/seq/seed/normalization?
lee: CI notes: batch=64, seq=128, seed=11, L2-normalize before quant. Baseline=conch-emb-512-fp16.
sam: Any numbers yet?
lee: First-pass numbers from 9001 (30k sample): baseline recall@10=0.815, sundial-int6 recall@10=0.776 (delta -4.8%). recall@1 baseline=0.605 -> sundial=0.562. silhouette dropped 0.34 -> 0.29. centroid cosine shift avg ~0.12.
maria: Pattern by query length?
lee: Yes — short queries (<6 tokens) worst: recall@1 down ~7.2%. Medium 6-24 down ~3.4%. Long >24 nearly unchanged.
sam: Can you paste a few id-flip examples (query, baseline top1, sundial top1, sims)?
lee: 3 short examples (trimmed):
1) Query: "install postgres" — baseline top1: doc#421 (install + init) sim=0.89, sundial top1: doc#990 (pg internals) sim=0.62
2) Query: "oauth token refresh" — baseline top1: doc#1202 (refresh flow) sim=0.87, sundial top1: doc#3498 (jwt rotate) sim=0.58
3) Query: "merge conflict" — baseline top1: doc#57 (conflict resolution) sim=0.85, sundial top1: doc#410 (rebase tips) sim=0.63
maria: That looks like semantic adjacency but bigger drop in confidence. Hypothesis: quantizer clipping or channel-scale mismatch. Also check per-token norm histograms.
sam: Agreed. Plan: (A) per-channel percentile clipping (0.999) then int6, (B) tiny affine calibration per-channel (learned scale+bias) before quantize, (C) light distillation (teacher=conch fp16, student=sundial-int6) on 300k pairs. Also compute Jaccard(top10) vs baseline in length buckets.
lee: Kicking follow-ups as CI jobs: 9002 (perc-clip), 9003 (affine-calib), 9004 (distill-lite). Links: https://ci.internal/9002 https://ci.internal/9003 https://ci.internal/9004. Will include PCA variance explained (first 32 comps), per-token norm histograms, silhouette per coarse label, and 50 id-flip samples per run.
maria: For distill, log recall vs steps and hold out a validation set to avoid overfitting to docs. Save top-20 hardest queries.
sam: If per-channel tricks don't close gap consider hybrid scheme: keep top-6 dims in int8/float16 or retrain with L2-normalization loss. Also check nearest-neighbor entropy (flat vs peaked).
lee: Good. Will attach a tiny repro notebook and sample dumps when jobs finish. ETA ~2.5 hours.
ci-bot: Jobs queued: 9002 ETA 1h20m, 9003 ETA 1h50m, 9004 ETA 3h05m. Job 9001 marked FAILED (regression threshold exceeded).
